title: AgentCapabilityRunRequest.v1
description: An agent consumer's request to RUN one governed CapabilityTask through the Teleon Agent Capability Gateway — the agent ASKS, Teleon EXECUTES. The consumer names itself (consumer_id) and the capability (capability_id), supplies the work either inline (payload, when small + non-sensitive) or by reference (input_ref, preferred when large or sensitive — exactly one is expected), carries the allowed_use it intends, a max_cost ceiling the run must not exceed, a freshness_requirement on any served facts, require_receipt to force an AgentCapabilityReceipt, and an idempotency_key so a retried request resolves to the same run. The agent cannot widen its own boundary here — only call capabilities already allowed to it; no raw secrets are passed (secret references live in the consumer's secret_policy, resolved only at the runtime boundary).

request_id.description: caller-assigned correlation id for this run request

consumer_id.description: id of the AgentCapabilityConsumer making the call (must already be allowed to call capability_id)

capability_id.description: id of the capability to run (must appear in the consumer's allowed_capabilities)

payload.description: inline input for the capability when small + non-sensitive; exactly one of payload or input_ref is expected

input_ref.description: ResourceRef-style handle (e.g. ctx://...) to the input when large or sensitive; preferred over inline payload; exactly one of payload or input_ref is expected

allowed_use.description: the uses the consumer intends for the output; checked against the capability's allowed_use/forbidden_use and carried onto the result + receipt

max_cost.description: hard cost ceiling for this run (e.g. {unit: 'usd', amount}); a run that would exceed it is not executed (returned as unavailable, not a partial charge)

freshness_requirement.description: the recency the consumer requires of any served facts (e.g. {max_age: '24h'}); if it cannot be met the run reports unavailable rather than serving stale facts

require_receipt.description: when true, the run MUST emit an AgentCapabilityReceipt or be treated as unavailable

idempotency_key.description: stable key so a retried request resolves to the same run/result instead of double-executing or double-charging
